Question:
What is the recommended torque for an 8-36 fine thread bolt with an MS20365 tension nut?

Source: AC-43.13-1B-CH7, section 7-41
AC 43.13-1B, Acceptable Methods, Techniques, and Practices: Aircraft Inspection and Repair, chapter 7 (aircraft hardware, control cables, and turnbuckles)
7-41 STANDARD AIRCRAFT HEX HEAD BOLTS (AN3 THROUGH AN20).

TABLE 7-1. Recommended torque values (inch-pounds). CAUTION: THE FOLLOWING TORQUE VALUES ARE DERIVED FROM OIL FREE CADMIUM PLATED THREADS.
| Thread size | Recommended for installation (bolts loaded primarily in shear): tension type nuts MS20365 and AN310 (40,000 psi in bolts) | Recommended for installation (bolts loaded primarily in shear): shear type nuts MS20364 and AN320 (24,000 psi in bolts) | Maximum allowable tightening torque: nuts MS20365 and AN310 (90,000 psi in bolts) | Maximum allowable tightening torque: nuts MS20364 and AN320 (54,000 psi in bolts) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
The above torque values may be used for all cadmium-plated steel nuts of the fine or coarse thread series which have approximately equal number of threads and equal face bearing areas. * Estimated corresponding values.
| Fine thread series |  |  |  |  |
| 8-36 | 12-15 | 7-9 | 20 | 12 |
| 10-32 | 20-25 | 12-15 | 40 | 25 |
| 1/4-28 | 50-70 | 30-40 | 100 | 60 |
| 5/16-24 | 100-140 | 60-85 | 225 | 140 |
| 3/8-24 | 160-190 | 95-110 | 390 | 240 |
| 7/16-20 | 450-500 | 270-300 | 840 | 500 |
| 1/2-20 | 480-690 | 290-410 | 1100 | 660 |
| 9/16-18 | 800-1000 | 480-600 | 1600 | 960 |
| 5/8-18 | 1100-1300 | 600-780 | 2400 | 1400 |
| 3/4-16 | 2300-2500 | 1300-1500 | 5000 | 3000 |
| 7/8-14 | 2500-3000 | 1500-1800 | 7000 | 4200 |
| 1-14 | 3700-5500 | 2200-3300* | 10,000 | 6000 |
| 1-1/8-12 | 5000-7000 | 3000-4200* | 15,000 | 9000 |
| 1-1/4-12 | 9000-11,000 | 5400-6600* | 25,000 | 15,000 |
| Coarse thread series |  |  |  |  |
| 8-32 | 12-15 | 7-9 | 20 | 12 |
| 10-24 | 20-25 | 12-15 | 35 | 21 |
| 1/4-20 | 40-50 | 25-30 | 75 | 45 |
| 5/16-18 | 80-90 | 48-55 | 160 | 100 |
| 3/8-16 | 160-185 | 95-100 | 275 | 170 |
| 7/16-14 | 235-255 | 140-155 | 475 | 280 |
| 1/2-13 | 400-480 | 240-290 | 880 | 520 |
| 9/16-12 | 500-700 | 300-420 | 1100 | 650 |
| 5/8-11 | 700-900 | 420-540 | 1500 | 900 |
| 3/4-10 | 1150-1600 | 700-950 | 2500 | 1500 |
| 7/8-9 | 2200-3000 | 1300-1800 | 4600 | 2700 |
The above torque values may be used for all cadmium-plated steel nuts of the fine or coarse thread series which have approximately equal number of threads and equal face bearing areas. * Estimated corresponding values.

**Source:** AC 43.13-1B, Chapter 7, Section 7-41, Table 7-1 (Fine thread series, column "Recommended for installation (bolts loaded primarily in shear): tension type nuts MS20365 and AN310 (40,000 psi in bolts)").
